items.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
items.z: 打扰一下，去火车站怎么走？

items.t: Is it within walking distance?
Go straight for two blocks and turn left.
items.z: 直走两个街区然后左转。

items.t: It's right across the street from the bank.
You can't miss it.
Which line do I take to get downtown?
Does this bus go to the airport?
How often does the train run?
I think I'm lost.
Could you show me on the map?
items.z: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？

items.t: Is this seat taken?
Where do I buy a ticket?
Can I get a transfer?
I'd like to go to this address, please.
Could you drop me off at the corner?
How long will it take to get there?
Traffic is terrible this time of day.
items.z: 这个时间段交通很糟糕。

items.t: I'll take a rideshare instead.
Watch your step getting off the bus.
Thanks, you've been a big help.
